# primitive2d_database89 v0.4.0 encyclopedic

Backend-agnostic C89/fixed-point 2D primitive recipe database.

- Previous v0.3 shapes preserved: 336
- New v0.4 shapes: 384
- Total named shapes: 720
- New submodules: 22
- Stable geometry ABI: POINT / MOVE / LINE / QUAD / CUBIC / CLOSE
- New semantic flags: repeatable tile, marker, diagram node, editor helper
- No heap and no floating point in C sources

See `docs/CATALOG.md`, `docs/MODULE_TREE.md`, `docs/WEB_RESEARCH_NOTES.md`, and `docs/TEST_REPORT.md`.
